# awscc_securityagent_artifact (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::SecurityAgent::Artifact



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `agent_space_id` (String) The unique identifier of the agent space to add the artifact to.
- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the artifact.
- `artifact_content` (String) The binary content of the artifact to upload, encoded as a Base64 string.
- `artifact_id` (String) The unique identifier assigned to the uploaded artifact.
- `artifact_type` (String) The file type of the artifact.
- `file_name` (String) The file name of the artifact.
- `updated_at` (String) The date and time the artifact was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.
